notes: 02: /api/metadata collects title, description, favicon but never a preview image (no og:image); cards show no preview image. 04: edit modal covers url/title/description/tags/collection but has no note field. 06: new saves do save([b,...bookmarks]) with no duplicate-url detection or convergence to editing. 10: tags are a plain comma-separated input with no autocomplete of existing tags. 11: tags render as non-clickable spans; only fixed collections filter, no per-tag filter. 12: search covers title/url/description/tags case-insensitively but note is not searchable (no note field). 14: no #tag syntax; query is a literal substring match. 15: no AND/OR/NOT or parentheses parsing. 16: no quoted-phrase exact match. 17: no unread flag/action; only a coincidental generic 'Read later' collection can be assigned. 18: viewing 'Read later' is just a collection filter, not an unread perspective. 19: no mark-as-read action removing an item from an unread list. 20: no multi-select/checkboxes or bulk actions. 21: no filter-scoped bulk apply. 22: sort control ('Recently added') is a static button with no handler; list keeps insertion order. 23: no note field or markdown rendering. 24: no local HTML snapshot and no PDF rule. 25: no Internet Archive integration. 26: no archived flag; 'Archive' is only an icon reused for the Unsorted nav. 27: no archive concept, so no archive-vs-delete distinction. 28: no archived list. 29: collections are static, not saved search+tag bundles. 30: no Netscape HTML import. 31: no export. 32: Settings button has no handler; no default-sort/displayed-items/font-size settings (grid/list toggle is unrelated and unpersisted).
